annotations.title: Leaving Japan: which resident tax (住民税) years are still owed, is a tax agent (納税管理人) needed, and what are the income-tax and move-out deadlines?

description: Checks what tax and paperwork are still due when someone leaves Japan, from the Local Tax Act (地方税法 39 / 294 / 300 / 318 / 321-5), Income Tax Act (所得税法 126 / 127 / 190), 国税通則法 117, 住民基本台帳法 24, MIC resident-tax pages, NTA Tax Answers 1920 / 1923 / 1926 / 1478 and the Japan Pension Service, rules as of 2026-11-01. Resident tax (住民税) is assessed on whoever is registered in a city on January 1, on the previous year's income, for the fiscal year June–May: leave (with a 転出届) on or before December 31 → no next-year 住民税; leave January 2 or later → that fiscal year is owed in full. Leaving January–May, the bill is issued mid-June after departure → tax agent (納税管理人) needed (or settle / city certification). Payroll deduction (特別徴収): job ending January 1 – April 30 → remaining installments taken as a lump sum from the final pay (mandatory); June–December → only on request. Income tax: year-end adjustment on the last salary before departure; if a return is needed, 準確定申告 by the departure date, or by March 15 next year via a tax agent notified to the tax office; previous year's return due by departure when leaving January 1 – March 15; exit-tax flag for ¥100M+ securities. Also the 転出届 window (~14 days before), pension Lump-sum Withdrawal claim deadline (2 years) and residence card. plan: leave (a year or more) | short (trip under a year → still resident). Returns verdict (agent_needed | settle_before_departure | nothing_after_departure | still_resident), summary, residentTax {fiscalYears [{fiscalYear, incomeYear, status owed | not_owed | check_with_city, why, howToPay}], nextFiscalYearAvoided, leaveByToAvoidNextFY, jan1Tip, lumpSumFromFinalPay, agentRequired, agentForm}, incomeTax {yearEndAdjustment, returnRequired, returnDeadline, previousYearReturnDeadline, agentRequired, agentForm, exitTax}, deadlines [{date, what, ja, mandatory, passed}], actions, warnings, pension {lumpSumClaimBy}, sources, disclaimer. No yen amounts. Use for 'leaving Japan resident tax', 'do I pay juminzei after leaving Japan', '住民税 出国 1月1日', '納税管理人 必要', 'leave Japan before December 31 tax', 'final salary resident tax lump sum', '準確定申告 出国'. Educational, not tax or legal advice; not affiliated with the NTA, MIC, any city office or the Japan Pension Service.

arrivalDate.description: When you first registered an address in Japan (default: before January 1 of the departure year).

departureDate.description: The day you leave Japan, YYYY-MM-DD.

hasTaxAgent.description: Will appoint a tax agent (納税管理人).

incomeAfterLeaving.description: Japan-source income after leaving (rent, property sale) → tax agent needed.

incomeLastYear.description: Had taxable income last calendar year (default true).

jobEndDate.description: Job end date (default: departureDate); decides the final-salary lump-sum rule.

nationality.description: foreign (default) | japanese (pension lump sum / residence card only for foreign nationals).

needsTaxReturn.description: Needs an income tax return this year (side income > ¥200k, salary > ¥20M, self-employed, two employers…). Default: true only for self_employed.

payMethod.description: How 住民税 is paid: salary (payroll, 特別徴収) | self (bills, 普通徴収) | none. Default from employment.

pensionMonths.description: Months of Japanese pension contributions (6–119 → lump-sum claim deadline).

plan.description: leave (moving abroad for a year or more, files a 転出届; default) | short (trip under a year, keeps the address).

prevYearReturnPending.description: Leaving January 1 – March 15 with last year's return not yet filed.

securities100M.description: Holds ¥100M+ in securities etc. → exit-tax (国外転出時課税) flag.

today.description: Override today's date (default: today in Japan).
